title: [v0.92.1][V3-C] C-SDLC v3 lifecycle kernel
body:
## Outcome

Produce one transactional C-SDLC v3 lifecycle-kernel slice.

## Primary deliverable

One transactional C-SDLC v3 lifecycle-kernel slice with recovery and typed adapters.

## Verification result

Transition, failure-injection, and recovery-replay tests pass for requirements 168 through 170.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly delivery of one transactional lifecycle-kernel slice; storage and adapters are inseparable implementation parts.

## Dependencies

- V3-B: #501

## Retained predecessor scope

- #168
- #169
- #170

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Transitions are capability-checked and atomic
- [ ] Recovery preserves audit provenance
- [ ] Requirements 168 through 170 pass failure-injection tests

## Owned paths

- `csdlc-v3/src/lifecycle/**`
- `csdlc-v3/src/storage/**`
- `csdlc-v3/src/adapters/**`
- `csdlc-v3/tests/transactions/**`

## PVF lanes

- `transition-matrix`
- `transaction-failure`
- `recovery-replay`
- `strict-clippy`

## Stop conditions

- Partial writes can acquire authority
- Recovery loses provenance

## Non-goals

- Publication
- v2 migration
